children: Launch Two entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Business Combination Agreement with NuCube, extending the Outside Date to Jan 7, 2027. The amendment permits NuCube to raise capital via Series A-4 Preferred Stock at $12.779 per share with 50% warrant coverage exercisable at $15.887, without reducing aggregate merger consideration. It also increases the post-closing incentive plan pool to 12.5% and requires a new employee stock purchase plan with a 2% reserve. The changes are intended to support financing and execution ahead of closing.
